decisions.label: Primary
decisions.description: Occurring first in time or sequence; original; of greatest rank or importance or value.

verification.note: NCIT:C25251 Primary; exact label match but the NCIT term is a general qualifier. In context of Biospecimen Incidence Type, 'Primary' denotes a specimen from the initial/primary tumor occurrence. General qualifier is the best available NCIT match; no specific specimen-incidence-type qualifier exists.

decisions.label: Progressive Disease
decisions.description: A clinical, pathologic, and/or molecular finding indicating that the course of a disease is worsening in terms of extent or severity.

verification.note: NCIT:C35571 Progressive Disease; label is Progressive Disease not Progression, but the disease-worsening sense fits this incidence type context.

decisions.label: Recurrent Disease
decisions.description: The return of a disease after a period of remission.

verification.note: NCIT:C38155 Recurrent Disease; label is Recurrent Disease not Recurrence, but the sense (disease returning after remission) matches this incidence type.

decisions.label: Neoplasm Metastasis
decisions.description: The spread of a neoplasm from the original site of growth to another site.

verification.note: NCIT:C19151 Neoplasm Metastasis; exact ontology concept for metastasis; used here as incidence type for specimens collected at metastatic phase.

decisions.label: Remission
decisions.description: A state in which the signs and symptoms of a disease are reduced or absent.

decisions.label: No Evidence of Disease
decisions.description: Diagnostic tests fail to detect presence of disease.

verification.note: NCIT:C40413 No Evidence of Disease; label differs (No Disease vs No Evidence of Disease) but the clinical sense matches — absence of detectable disease.
